name: Digest and Run Gel
description: In-silico restriction digest and gel electrophoresis simulation

hostContract.styling: Tailwind CSS with shadcn-style theme tokens (bg-card, bg-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-accent, bg-muted, ring-ring, accent-primary)
hostContract.enzymes: Per-site restriction enzyme list from project data: [{ name, recSeq, cutIndex, botCutIndex, cutType?, methylationBlocked? }]; cutIndex is the 0-based position the cut falls before
hostContract.localStorage: Reads the host's `enzymeFilter` value once for the default enzyme group; falls back to 'unique+twice'
